1. Why are you running for City Council?
2. What are the three key environmental issues you see for Berkeley in the next two to four years?
3. What is your view about housing projects in Berkeley and in-fill housing?
4. What can Berkeley do to further enhance its creeks and to promote creek restoration?
5. As a council member you will get a chance to sit on various countywide advisory bodies. Are there environmental issues that you would like to promote or work on at the countywide level?
6. What is your vision for the San Pablo Avenue corridor from Oakland to Richmond?
7. What is your view of vegetation management along the Urban/Wildland Interface?
8. What is your position regarding the proposal for the Trust for Public Land and East Bay Regional Park District to purchase Golden Gate Fields for a park. What would you want to see on that site?
9. How should Berkeley address sea level rise and the development of a RSAP?
10. What is your position on the proposed Berkeley Ferry? What do you see are the environmental issues concerning the Berkeley Ferry?
10. [second question numbered 10 on the form] What is your vision for integrating an environmental vision for Berkeley with the needs of Berkeley residents for economic development?
11. Please identify those you consider your key supporters.

All candidates must agree to sign a pledge on the use of the League endorsement and its name and logo. If you will not sign it, please explain why you will not. — "I pledge not to misrepresent any League support of me nor any of my opponents; nor to quote the League to give any such misimpressions. I pledge to represent the League position honestly and fully, and to seek guidance from the League on interpretation of this pledge."

League of Conservation Voters of the East Bay — Confidential Questionnaire for Berkeley City Council, November 2026. Transcribed from the .docx, verbatim.

CONFIDENTIAL per the form's own title.

NOTE ON IDENTITY — this is the League of CONSERVATION Voters, not the League of Women Voters. A due date of August 21 was given verbally for "League of…"; confirm which body it belongs to before relying on it.

FORM QUIRK. The form numbers two consecutive questions as 10; both are kept here.

ENDORSEMENT PLEDGE. Endorsement requires signing a pledge governing use of the League name and logo, or explaining why not.
